body.p: The Content Reuse Finder view helps you locate similar content in your project or in topics referenced in the DITA Maps Manager view. It works with any kind of XML document and can also be applied on HTML and Markdown documents that are not well-formed.
If the view is not displayed, you can open it from WindowShow View. By default, it appears in the top-right section of the editor.
The view includes the following information and options:

ul.li: Scope - The first sentence shows the source scope for the search (Project, or specific project folder, or DITA Maps Manager view).
Enter a list of element names that might contain similar content - You can specify specific element types to be restricted from the search.
Show similar content for the current file - Limits the results to the currently open file.
Ignore stop words - Excludes common stop words (e.g. and or the) from the similarity analysis.

Similarity threshold (0-100%) - Controls how closely content must match to be included in the results. Possible values are:
100% Identical - Default setting.
~95% Near mirror - Small differences, typos.
~90% Highly similar - Minor variations, same word order.
~80% Same meaning - Similar, but not identical.
~50% Related - Similar, but not closely so.
Find similar content - Click this button to start the search.

body.p: Results are displayed in the Results view grouped by similar findings. If you double-click on each group of similar elements in the same Results view, you can see a precise list of elements that are similar.

If the AI Positron add-on is installed, the Analyze with AI action is available in the contextual menu for the Content Reuse Finder results. Use this action to send selected reuse candidates to AI Positron so it can help you review the matches, understand the differences, and create or update reusable content.

To use the action, select one or more entries in the Results view, then right-click and select Analyze with AI. The action is available both for grouped results and for the detailed list of matches within a group.
